description: This file defines the 'Origin' struct and related functions for tracking resource origins in kustomize, including methods for copying, appending paths, and creating origins from custom plugins.

classes.name: Origin
classes.description: Struct holding information about resource origin, including path, repo, ref, and configuration details.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Origin instance.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Returns a new Origin with a path appended, resolving remote URLs if applicable.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Serializes the Origin to a YAML string.

methods.name: String (Transformations)
methods.description: Serializes a list of Origins to a YAML string.

methods.name: OriginFromCustomPlugin
methods.description: Creates an Origin object from a custom plugin resource.
